plan: A serpent mage who poisons and bites non-stop, and petrifies those who look at her.
aSurveiller: Her R (Petrifying Gaze). If you face her you are stunned, otherwise only slowed: turn your back on her.
contrer: Turn your back when she casts her R: from behind you are only slowed.
Engage her up close: she has no escape spell.
Inside her clouds (W), you can't use your movement spells.

sorts.P: Faster thanks to her serpent nature.
sorts.Q: Area poison that speeds her up.
sorts.E: Bite that hits harder on poisoned targets.

momentFort: Fragile in the early game. She then becomes very hard to kill and very strong in the late game.
